preconditions.description: The number of objects n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(type_i in {0, 1} for type_i in types)
preconditions.description: Each type_i must be either 0 (mountain) or 1 (hotel).
There must be at least one hotel among the objects.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each a_i must be a valid index or zero, indicating no track leading to the object.

postconditions.description: The path length k must be at least 1.
The output must contain the path length k followed by the path indices.

postconditions.expression: all(types[v - 1] == 0 for v in path[:-1]) and types[path[-1] - 1] == 1
postconditions.description: The path must consist of mountains followed by a hotel.
